what: Partition handoff lacks check-plan-size rc=0 guard
scenario_or_breakage: Plan adds partition_requested→LOOP_STATUS=plan-size-trigger when no hard trigger, but rc2/rc3 is only warn-and-continue. Step 2b.5 returns before partition/hard branches on rc2/rc3. Loop could still set plan-size-trigger after a failed size check and route to Split/Override incorrectly
suggested_fix: Gate partition handoff on check-plan-size rc=0 (early return after rc2/rc3 warn path, mirroring Step 2b.5 step 3). Add test-plan-review-loop case: partition_requested=true plus forced rc2/3 must not emit LOOP_STATUS=plan-size-trigger
